# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent = seed (cand_0001 was REJECTED — broke `exceltable-in-ppt`, whole batch reverted).
Strategy: re-introduce the cand_0001 edits that FIXED tasks (LEDGER: sales-pivot,
offer-letter) + verified-safe knowledge fixes, DROP the one behavioral edit that touched
the passing task's path ("inspect ONCE"), and ADD a new pdf value-normalization fix that
cand_0001 lacked. Recovered the reverted files from git (`005e781:candidates/cand_0001/`).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | no `python` binary (exit 127) on every task | all 10 (esp. weighted-gdp budget) | env has only `python3`; every `python …` wastes a turn retrying; gdp t0 dies out of budget partly from this + pandas-missing retry | KNOWLEDGE/ENV | command correction `python`→`python3` + env note |
| 2 | fake pivot vs native PivotTable | sales-pivot-analysis (0.00×5) | openpyxl can't create pivots; agent writes pandas summary → no `xl/pivotTables/*` parts; grader reads `ws._pivots[0]` | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW bundled `pivot.py` |
| 3 | title not paragraph-centered | pptx-reference-formatting (0.00×5) | grader checks `pPr.get('algn')=='ctr'`; agent only re-positions the box, never sets paragraph algn; also hardcodes 9144000 slide width | KNOWLEDGE | ooxml.md centering section + SKILL pointer |
| 4 | conditional template filler | offer-letter-generator (flaky 0.40) | multi-paragraph `{{IF_}}` block + inner placeholders left literal; gate key is `RELOCATION_PACKAGE` not tag `RELOCATION` | BEHAVIORAL/CAPABILITY | NEW bundled `fill_template.py` |
| 5 | PDF↔Excel diff wrong count | pdf-excel-diff (flaky 0.20) | (a) `tables[0][1:]`/per-page `[1:]` drops rows; (b) `"112,000"` (PDF str) vs `112000` (int) → false/missed "modified" | KNOWLEDGE/BEHAVIORAL | pdf multi-page recipe + NEW `norm()` compare recipe |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | command correction | pptx/SKILL.md, xlsx/SKILL.md, pdf/forms.md (`python `→`python3 `) + xlsx env note | env has no `python`; use `python3`, prefer openpyxl (pandas may be absent). General env fact. | exceltable already self-corrects to python3 → only removes a wasted step; cannot regress |
| 2 | NEW script | xlsx/pivot.py + concise "Creating PivotTables" section | build real `xl/pivotTables`+`xl/pivotCache` via openpyxl low-level classes, any row/col/value/agg | new file + inert prose; exceltable never makes a pivot |
| 3 | reference knowledge | pptx/ooxml.md "Positioning and centering a shape" + SKILL step-3 pointer | `algn="ctr"` per paragraph (first child of `<a:p>`) AND read real `<p:sldSz>` width; centering = align + position | additive reference read in full; exceltable never centers text |
| 4 | NEW script | docx/fill_template.py + Conditional-Sections rewrite | fills inner placeholders of kept blocks, gate-by-related-key, multi-paragraph include-stack, verifies no `{{}}` left | docx unused by exceltable (zero blast) |
| 5 | recipe (knowledge) | pdf/SKILL.md Advanced Table Extraction rewrite + `norm()` compare recipe | header-once multi-page extraction; canonicalize both sides before equality (strip `,`/`$`, coerce numeric, casefold text); cast numpy for json | pdf unused by exceltable (zero blast) |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: target trace → what it now does; + blast radius)
- pivot.py: built 3 pivots on a synthetic source; `zipfile` shows `xl/pivotTables/pivotTable{1,2,3}.xml` + `xl/pivotCache/*`; readback `ws._pivots[0]` → rowField=STATE, subtotal=sum/count, colField=Quarter — matches grader parametrization `[('...','sum',None),('...','count',None),('...','sum','quarter')]`. Blast: new file; exceltable never calls it → cannot fire.
- fill_template.py: on multi-paragraph `{{IF_RELOCATION}}` gated by `RELOCATION_PACKAGE:"Yes"` → keeps block, fills `{{RELOCATION_AMOUNT}}`→`$5,000`, no `{{}}` left (fixes t1+t2); `"No"` → removes content, no leftovers. Blast: docx unused by exceltable.
- norm() compare: `"112,000"`==`112000` True, `"$1,200.50"`==`1200.5` True, `"Engineering"`==`"engineering"` True, `"112,000"`==`115000` False, `"4.5"`==`4.6` False — kills the 10495-false-positive bug and the 18-vs-20 miss. Blast: pdf unused by exceltable.
- python3: env confirmed — every trajectory (exceltable, gdp, reserves, xlsx-recover) hits `/bin/bash: line 1: python: command not found` (exit 127) then retries `python3`. Making python3 the default removes the failed attempt. Blast: exceltable's unpack/recalc succeed on python3 today → strictly fewer wasted turns, no output change.
- centering section: additive; grader asserts `algn=="ctr"` which the section now teaches. Blast: exceltable reads ooxml.md in full (t0/t4) but never centers → inert content.

## Process & features used
- Subagents/parallel: YES. 4 read-only `general-purpose` subagents in parallel diagnosed (a) the passing task exceltable for blast-radius, (b) pivot+pptx-center, (c) offer/pdf/gdp, (d) the 4 hard-failing tasks. Then serial edits (I had all recovered content; no worktrees needed).
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 PROCESS.md + diff.patch (docx-only in archive) + recovered full tree from git commit 005e781. Learned: cand_0001 fixed sales-pivot & offer-letter but broke exceltable → whole batch reverted. Its only behavioral change to exceltable's path was the xlsx "inspect ONCE" rule; everything else was inert/self-correcting per the exceltable trace. So I keep the fixers, drop inspect-once.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- xlsx/pivot.py (native PivotTable builder), docx/fill_template.py (conditional filler),
  the pptx centering reference, the pdf multi-page+`norm()` recipe, and `python3` commands.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- financial-modeling-qa (0.00): deterministic wrong answer 24 from ModelOff dice-rule
  misreading — task-specific domain compute; no general lever; encoding the answer overfits.
- reserves-at-risk-calc (0.00): required IMF download returns HTTP 403 / BlobNotFound;
  network defect, unwinnable regardless of formula quality. (python3 note still reduces its friction.)
- invoice-fraud-detection (flaky 0.40): pure fuzzy-match-threshold / reason-priority
  accuracy variance; no recurring mechanical/env defect a general edit fixes.
- xlsx-recover-data (0.00): decisive `test_growth_values` is task-specific CAGR definition;
  t0 is docker/infra noise ("do not optimize"). No general lever flips it.
- DROPPED from cand_0001: xlsx "inspect the workbook ONCE" rule — regression suspect
  (only behavioral change to exceltable's inspection path) and low leverage (one trial of
  an already-0.80 task); python3 relieves gdp's budget pressure without that risk.
